answer.question: What is the sales internship at Icanio Tech School?
answer.answer: It is a practical sales and marketing program for students and career switchers. You move through four phases: sales fundamentals, lead generation and CRM, go-to-market and closing, then sales analytics and career preparation. You run three live campaigns, manage an Odoo CRM pipeline under a 1:1 mentor and earn a certificate. Durations run from 15 days to six months.

sections.heading: What a sales professional does and why it pays to learn
paragraphs: Sales is the job of turning interest into revenue. A salesperson finds businesses or people who might need a product, starts a conversation, understands their problem and shows how the product solves it. Then they handle doubts, agree terms and keep the customer happy after the deal.

Every company needs this skill, whether it sells software, machinery, education or services. In B2B markets, and especially in IT services, a single well-run pipeline can decide a quarter. Yet many freshers have never written a cold email, logged a lead in a CRM or handled a real objection.

A sales internship lets you practise all of that with support. Our sales internship is structured around the full cycle, from the first prospecting message to the closed deal and the report that follows it.
bullets: Research and prospect leads on LinkedIn and email
Qualify and score leads in a CRM pipeline
Pitch, handle objections and negotiate terms
Track pipeline metrics and report on results

items.title: Aspiring entrepreneurs

items.title: Early-career professionals

sections.heading: A typical week in the sales internship
paragraphs: Each week of the sales internship starts with a pipeline review. You and your mentor look at your leads in Odoo CRM, agree which ones to chase and set a target for new conversations that week.

Midweek is for outreach. You research prospects on LinkedIn Sales Navigator, write personalised emails, make calls and log every touch in the CRM. You also practise pitches and role-play common objections, so real conversations feel familiar when they come.

At the end of the week you look at the numbers: replies, meetings booked and deals moved forward. Your mentor asks what worked and what to change. We recommend this weekly rhythm because, in our experience, sales confidence comes from steady repetition and honest feedback, not from one big pitch.

faqs.q: Who is eligible for the sales internship?
faqs.a: Students and graduates from any stream can apply. The sales internship suits final-year students, fresh graduates, career switchers from customer service or retail, aspiring entrepreneurs and early-career business professionals. You do not need prior sales experience. Our team will look at your background and suggest a duration that fits.

faqs.q: I am an introvert. Can I still do well in sales?
faqs.a: Yes. Good selling depends more on listening, preparation and follow-up than on being loud. Many strong salespeople are quiet and thoughtful. The internship gives you scripts, role-play and steady practice, so your confidence grows with each conversation. Your mentor will help you find a style that suits you.

faqs.q: How long is the sales internship?
faqs.a: You choose the duration, from 15 days up to six months. A short internship covers fundamentals and lead generation in depth. Three to six months lets you complete all four phases, run three live campaigns and finish the full go-to-market capstone. Our team helps you decide based on your goals.

faqs.q: Which tools will I use in the sales internship?
faqs.a: You work with Odoo CRM for pipeline management, Apollo.io for email outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator for B2B prospecting and Google Analytics for tracking. You also use Canva and Figma to create sales collateral and pitch decks. Together they cover the full modern sales workflow.

faqs.q: Can I do the sales internship online?
faqs.a: Yes. You can attend offline at our centre, join online, or choose part-time weekday or weekend batches. Hybrid is also possible. Online interns get the same 1:1 mentorship, pipeline reviews and certificate as offline interns, so choose whatever fits your college timetable best.

faqs.q: What campaigns will I run during the internship?
faqs.a: You run three campaigns: a lead generation campaign, a nurture email sequence and a capstone go-to-market plan for a real or simulated business. For each you set targets, execute the outreach and report on results. Together they show employers you can plan and deliver, not just talk about selling.

faqs.q: Will I get a certificate and placement support?
faqs.a: Every intern who completes the sales internship receives an Icanio Tech School certificate stating the track and duration. Phase 4 includes sales resume building and interview coaching. Top performers are referred to the Icanio Technologies talent team, and our wider programs have placed over 1,000 students.

faqs.q: Should I choose sales or digital marketing?
faqs.a: Choose sales if you enjoy one-to-one conversations, persuasion and closing deals. Choose digital marketing if you enjoy content, channels and audience data. The two overlap in lead generation and campaign planning. If you are unsure, talk to our team, or read about our digital marketing internship before you apply.

takeaways: The sales internship covers fundamentals, lead generation, CRM, pitching, closing and sales analytics in four phases.
You run three live campaigns and manage a real Odoo CRM pipeline under a 1:1 mentor.
It suits students from any stream, career switchers, aspiring entrepreneurs and early-career professionals.

You finish with an Icanio Tech School certificate, a go-to-market plan and interview coaching.
conclusion: Sales is one of the few careers where your results speak for themselves. Our sales internship gives you real pipelines to work, real conversations to practise and a mentor who reviews every step.

If you are a student in Tamil Nadu who enjoys people and targets, start with one prospect list and one well-written email. Apply below, talk to our team, and we will help you plan the right duration for your sales internship.
